comment: He's such an interesting guy and really cares about what he's teaching. He's a little odd, but his jokes are really funny. He's also very smart, which sometimes makes it hard for him to teach ideas that come easy to him, but I learned so much in his class. There are readings, but you don't really need to do them.

The class was lecture heavy, but the material was really interesting so most days it was easy to stay engaged although it could definitely get boring. There were four essays that were on broad, engaging topics, but you have to try your best to get an A. He's a super quirky guy and he really cares about his students and the topic.

Tom is absolutely wonderful. Towards the beginning, his class can start out pretty confusing, but as the semester goes on people are able to get the hang of his teaching style. Pretty lecture heavy, but touches on many different areas and is hilarious.

Tom is the nicest guy and he is pretty funny, but his teaching style is not suitable for anyone not in psychology. He has a strict technology usage policy that makes it incredibly boring to sit through his lectures, where he literally just rereads the readings from the previous day. He made several students uncomfortable for a variety of reasons.

A nice guy but I didn't love his teaching style. Assigned readings but went over them in class. Calls on students to read every class. I didn't get much out of this class and I dreaded going. He cares about his students but will share personal information about his students in front of other students.

The best professor I ever had. If you have to take a French class, choose Thomas. He is absolutely hilarious; there wasn't a single class when I didn't laugh. He is an extremely easy grader, and he values progress over perfection. I hated French before taking his class, and now I am minoring in it. Loved him!!!!

Genuinely one of the best experiences I've ever had in the classroom. While I had to take French for a Gen Ed. requirement, he made the class into one I looked forward to attending everyday. While it's sometimes difficult to understand concepts when they're only explained in French, he goes out of his way to help you and see you succeed.

Thomas, what a guy. A kind and hilarious teacher who makes class engaging and interacts with students with effort that I have never experienced from a teacher before. Homework load wasn't too bad and exams were pretty cut and dry. Was sometimes hard to understand his explanations of grammar, but your TA can help explain it to you, HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

If teaching doesn't work out, Thomas could have a career as a comedian. He is a hilarious and kind man who works hard to know each of his students. I hate the French language, and was still excited to go to each class because of how fun and engaging he made it. HOWEVER, he only talks in French, and he was not good at teaching grammar - hurt grade!

If teaching doesn't work out, Thomas could have a career as a comedian. I despise the French language, and I was still excited to go to each class because he made it so engaging and funny. He works hard to get to know everyone in his class, and he's very including. HOWEVER, he was pretty bad at explaining/ teaching grammar. He only talks in French!

I took German 101 and 102 with Herr Doktor Bonfiglio in 1987-88.   I can still speak a surprising amount of German in spite of not carrying forward witht the language.  His teaching method was excellent and while  demanding it was always a class I looked forward to,   He is a gifted Language teacher.  If you get a chance take one of his courses

Thomas is super hilarious. Participation matters in this class and there will be a lot of homework and exams throughout the semester. Fren 221 is a very easy French class. What's between me and an easy A is participation. French is Thomas's third language but his pronunciation is very clear. Awesome choice for Fren221.
Thomas is the best professor I've ever had in 14 years of schooling. He makes the class so fun and engaging and we all got so close. I also have never learned so much. WE LOVE THOMAS!

Super nice guy that does his best to learn as much as he can about you. The class is a little more difficult than you'd like, and have nearly fallen asleep during a number of our classes. He really enjoys lecturing, it is just a really dry subject more often than not.

Thomas is incredibly dedicated and caring. However, this course can be incredibly difficult if you do not put the work in outside of classes. He is not the best at explaining the grammatical topics in class, but the workbook and textbook has good explanations. Homework is due for the week on Friday, but doing it regularly will make your life easier

I took Ling 203 with Tom Fall 2019. I was a bit worried in the beginning bc I really knew nothing about linguistics. However, Tom truly won me over and he is such a gem!!
So far my favorite professor at UR, he teaches well and is so hilarious!
Even if you struggle, as long as you put in the work and show up to office hours you should be good.
Boring and non-engaged class but easy A

I loved Tom-- both a great guy and professor. Definitely shares his political opinions, but it was a class critiquing capitalism so you sign up for what you get. Very intellectual and truly respects his students. He is a strict grader but doesn't have a solid rubric. It is definitely possible to get an A, but you need to want it and work for it.

He doesn't know how to keep a class engaged and the rather boring course content doesn't help. However, it's an easy A and you don't even need to do the readings cuz he reads from the book during the class either way. Bottom line, if you want knowledge go elsewhere. If you want an A, this is your place to be

Tom is an absolute gem! Even if you don't agree with the content, the whole point is to expose yourself to a psychoanalytic perspective on capitalism, and you learn a lot in that sense. You can breeze by without doing the readings, just get a little participation in and work on the essays. Follow his essay criteria and you're set for a good grade.

I think very highly of him and his methods, yet have an unusual anecdote. I reached out to him regarding an inconsistency between the syllabus and an assignment, one he likely would've noticed were it not the same syllabus another professor in another (German) course used. The reply had: "it's only _ % of your grade" like the principle isn't the pt

Super fun and easy class! Tom is an endearing, eccentric prof who is committed to connecting with his students. His lectures can get dull at times, but aren't hard to follow along with even if you don't do the readings. The overall experience you have definitely depends on how willing you are to follow his crackpot, classism theories and engage :)

Tom really knows what he's talking about which you can tell because he always has an accurate justification for anything taught in class. Really chill professor, understands and gives extensions and pointers. The papers feel a bit stressful but if you follow his criteria, you should be good. Get to know him outside class, it's such a pleasure!

Tom is a real intellectual, and always brings lots of energy and humor to the class. He clearly cares about you, and you will probably be fine if you don't do the homework reading every now and then. I would take this class 5 more times if I could

yeah don't take tom's psychopathology FYS. very little genuine educational value, mostly freudian ramblings. he is a very nice man and entertaining, but I got very little out of it. easy grader and readings are light, no tests. don't take an fys with him if you actually want to learn about anything besides his personal opinions.

very informal, encourages participation but most students are too confused to even know the answer. not helpful when asked for additional assistance, lectures are long winded and hard to take notes on, most times the textbook is more helpful for completing assignments. Manageable workload, but difficult to complete without explicit instruction.

DO NOT take the Psychopathology of American Capitalism FYS. I got catfished into this class because I thought it would be interesting. Tom is incredibly chaotic, often problematic, and spends the majority of class on tangents. Every time he asks a question students ask him to repeat it because they are so confused.

I never liked French in high school but Tom made it so fun that I looked forward to class everyday. Homework for the week was always due on Friday so you could do it at your own pace. He is so funny and genuinely cares about all of his students. Take this class!!!!!
One of the most lively and charismatic teachers Ive ever had. If you dont take him for French, I definitely recommend taking his other course.

Professor Bonfiglio seems to never have much of a plan. Every day, we go into class and read his book aloud. Sometimes, we watch videos too. He is very unclear when it comes time to write a paper. He gives us two page long prompts, making it necessary to search for the essay question for more time than it takes to actually write the paper.

Tom's quite the character, but fairly easy class to sit through. not demanding in workload at all. as long as you pay attention and write on a topic you're interested in, almost guaranteed at least a 90 on your papers

I love Tom he is such a gem. He has interesting lectures, a lot of participation. The only thing I REALLY hated was that he used the n-word in class, my FYS was language, race, and ethnicity, but it was really inappropriate and he only stopped after students got really upset. I got A's on my papers from him but I know a lot of my friends struggled

I had Tom for Intro to Linguistics and his class is definitely one of my favorites at UR! He is such a gem! Told us to call me Tom rather than Dr. Bonfiglio the first class and he is so nice to everyone and really wanted you to succeed his course. His workload is very manageable. Honestly he's the reason I minored in Linguistics!
Thomas is an amazing teacher. If you have the chance to take him for any class, do it. He makes class fun and engaging, and you will never be bored. Highly recommended!

Toma is AMAZING. If you can take french 221 with him, do it!! Class is always entertaining, and I feel like I've learned more in his class in 1 semester than in all of my high school french classes combined. If you pay attention (which isn't hard, he makes the class super engaging) and study a bit for the tests, you'll do well. LOVED him!

Thomas is the best French professor I have ever had.  I highly recommend taking him. We speak French the entire time but he speaks slowly and is understanding of limited knowledge starting off with. I have learned so much and he honestly makes the class fun.

Tom is awesome. I learned a lot. I figured out that you never have to read as long as you go to class. Work very hard on papers and go to his office hours to talk about your ideas and you should do well. He is one of my favorite teachers.

Very quirky, makes for an incredibly exciting class! He really wants you to think for yourself. Getting a paper back is a little rough at first, but Tom just likes his papers written just as his guidelines describe, and your grades will progress if you follow them. I strongly suggest getting to know the guy.
I loved taking a class from Thom.  He's a little weird, but he knows his stuff, and he teaches well.

Tom is so awesome! He is so funny and engaging! He makes CORE so interesting and relatable to everyday life. He's such a sweet guy and genuinely cares about his students. He goes out of his way to learn more about us and get us to think outside of the box. He's the best prof EVER!

Thomas is the best teacher ever! You don't speak a word of French from Day 1. You talk about the best things... homosexuality, marijuana...Paris Hilton... and these subjects are on a regular basis. He's so random. You learn the language, and he's understanding about having other classes and assignments. He makes participation easy, & its always fun

AMAZING!!! Thomas is by far the funiest man I have ever met. He never stops moving and we talk about the weirdest things in class like homophobia and alchohol, always always always entertaining! I have never heard him speak a word of english, you really use the language. I'd take another class with him any day! :D
He is just the best!!! The most interesting and the best prof in the UofR!!! Very engaging and entertaining and you'll learn a lot!!!

What a great guy! Had him for Contemporary Literary Theory, which sounds difficult, but he made it fun and easy. Medium hard grader, but classes are fun and interesting. He's super nice and willing to e-mail all night until your questions are answered.
Tom is the ideal professor.. he's a genius, and keeps things interesting. I've learned more in his class than in all my others combined. Take him for anything you can!
TOM IS THE BEST TEACHER EVER!!!!  HE IS AWESOMEEEEE.

Tom is such a great guy! He's extremely positive and really understanding. If you really can't get your paper done on time, he'll give you an extension. Great teacher, great person. Not too challenging, but challanging enough.
very positive
Terrific teacher.  Certainly not an easy A - but who cares, as long is the class is engaging and you learn lots.

Tom's style of teaching has been my gold standard (I worked as a teacher for 1.5 years after graduating). He's very interested in teaching, but despite the helpfulness of only speaking German in class, he could be a bit clearer to those who are less gifted with languages.
Best teacher I have had at this school Very hard...but funny and willing to help.  He actually bit someone in class...so needless to say you will never fall asleep in his class
visibly loves teaching, more so than any professor i've ever met
he is faaaantastic for core. he really wants know everyone in the class and he wants everyone to understand the material, enjoy it, and learn from one another. he is a genuinely wonderful person.

It has been over 15 years since I took his courses, and I still remember them fondly.  And although my career path did not include German as a major element, I still avidly study the language, culture and people.  This continued life study he inspired.  If I still lived in Richmond, I would love to take a class of his again.  He's that memorable.

Tom was outstanding and helped maintain my love for German.  He was crazy too!!  He always entertained the class while teaching us.  Years later, he wrote me a letter of recommendation.  Now I'm entering my 6th year teaching high school German.  Definitely take a class with Tom!!

Very talented teacher. You want to experience  German lang and culture, he is the right prof. Admires int students and initiates very intersing discussions. I thank him for getting me into grad school/loves Bg students/:-))and for learning German from him. Smarty and funny guy!

This is a hoot, found this googling Tom´s name. He was my Prof for senior year German a long, long time ago and one of my favorites. He´s an excellent teacher and a good guy. Anybody who can make the 12 Cases of German comprehensible like he can is doing a good job.
No Comments

Energetic! Occasionally he underestimates students or insists that he's right on one point or another, and it can be frustrating, but he's otherwise quite interested in students' welfare and academic development. And class is never boring.

Very engaging, interested teacher.  Cheerful, loud, organized.  The 6 credit language classes can be a pain, but he made it a lot better.  always easy to reach out of class, helpful and interested in each student.  language genius.
